message.content:
**Paris Get‑away Planner – 7 Days (Mid‑Season, €1,200–€2,000 per person)**  

> *Assumes you’ll fly into Paris‑Charles de Gaulle (CDG) or Orly (ORY) from a major European hub.  
>  Adjust dates, budget, and length as needed.*

---

## 1️⃣ Pre‑Trip Checklist

| Item | Tips |
|------|------|
| **Passport & Visa** | Valid for 6 months. EU/Schengen visa not required for most travelers. |
| **Travel Insurance** | Covers health, trip cancellation, lost luggage. |
| **Currency** | Euro (€). Credit cards accepted everywhere; keep a small amount of cash for metro tokens. |
| **Packing** | Light layers, comfortable walking shoes, umbrella, power adapter (Type C/F). |
| **Apps** | Citymapper (public transport), Google Maps, TripAdvisor, RATP (metro), Booking.com, Airbnb. |
| **Health** | COVID‑19 rules are relaxed; keep a mask handy for crowded places. |

---

## 2️⃣ Flights & Airport Transfers

| Option | Approx. Cost (per person) | Notes |
|--------|---------------------------|-------|
| **Direct flight** (e.g., from London Heathrow) | €120–€200 | 1‑hour flight |
| **Connecting flight** (via Frankfurt, Amsterdam) | €80–€150 | Longer travel time but cheaper |
| **Train** (Eurostar from London) | €100–€180 | 2 h 20 min, no security lines |
| **Airport transfer** | €10–€15 (shared shuttle) | Or private taxi (€35–€45) |

**Recommendation:** Book 3–4 months in advance for best fares. Use fare‑comparison sites (Google Flights, Skyscanner).

---

## 3️⃣ Accommodation

| Budget | Example Hotels / Hostels | Price Range (per night) | Highlights |
|--------|--------------------------|------------------------|------------|
| **Luxury** | Four Seasons George V, Ritz Paris | €600–€900 | 5‑star service, iconic rooms |
| **Mid‑range** | Hotel Le Six (Latin Quarter), Hôtel de la Porte Dorée | €120–€180 | Boutique feel, central |
| **Budget** | Generator Paris (Marais), St Christopher’s Inn | €30–€60 | Social vibe, good location |
| **Airbnb** | Studio in Montmartre, 1‑bedroom in Le Marais | €80–€140 | Local experience, kitchen |

**Tip:** Book a place with a kitchenette if you want to save on meals.

---

## 4️⃣ Transportation in Paris

| Mode | Cost | Frequency | Best For |
|------|------|-----------|----------|
| **Metro & RER** | €1.90 per ride (single ticket) | Every 2–3 min | City core |
| **Navigo Week Pass** | €22.80 | Unlimited | 7‑day pass (valid Monday‑Sunday) |
| **Bicycle (Vélib’)** | €1.90 per hour | 24/7 | Short trips, scenic routes |
| **Taxi / Uber** | €30–€50 (short rides) | On demand | Late night, airport |
| **Walking** | Free | 10–15 min | Most attractions within walking distance |

---

## 5️⃣ 7‑Day Itinerary (Sample)

> **Day 1 – Arrival & Settling In**  
> • Arrive, take the RER B to your hotel.  
> • Evening stroll along the Seine, dinner at a classic bistro (e.g., **Le Coupe Chou**).  

> **Day 2 – Classic Landmarks**  
> • Morning: Notre‑Dame & Sainte‑Chapelle (free entry to the cathedral).  
> • Lunch at **Café Marly** (views of Louvre).  
> • Afternoon: Louvre Museum (skip‑the‑line ticket).  
> • Evening: Seine river cruise (Bateaux Mouches) – €15.  

> **Day 3 – Montmartre & Artistic Vibes**  
> • Morning: Sacré‑Coeur, walk through Place du Tertre.  
> • Lunch at **Le Consulat**.  
> • Afternoon: Musée de Montmartre or the Espace Dalí.  
> • Evening: Moulin Rouge show (optional, €120+).  

> **Day 4 – Day Trip to Versailles**  
> • Take RER C to Versailles Château (train €7.50 each way).  
> • Guided tour of the palace and gardens (€25).  
> • Return to Paris, dinner in the Latin Quarter.  

> **Day 5 – Modern & Shopping**  
> • Morning: Centre Pompidou (modern art).  
> • Lunch at **Le Georges** (roof‑top).  
> • Afternoon: Shopping on Rue Saint‑Honoré & Galeries Lafayette.  
> • Evening: Attend a jazz club (e.g., **Le Caveau de la Huchette**).  

> **Day 6 – Hidden Gems**  
> • Morning: Canal Saint‑Martin walk, brunch at **Café Charlot**.  
> • Visit the **Musée des Arts Décoratifs** or **Musée Rodin**.  
> • Afternoon: Explore the Marais, visit **Picasso Museum**.  
> • Evening: Dinner at **L’As du Fallafel** (iconic falafel).  

> **Day 7 – Relax & Departure**  
> • Morning: Picnic in Luxembourg Gardens.  
> • Last‑minute souvenir shopping.  
> • Head to the airport via RER or taxi.  

---

## 6️⃣ Dining Highlights (per person)

| Dish | Restaurant | Approx. Cost |
|------|------------|--------------|
| Croissant & café au lait | **Du Pain et des Idées** | €4 |
| Escargot | **Le Relais de l’Entrecôte** | €12 |
| Coq au vin | **Le Procope** | €18 |
| Macarons | **Ladurée** | €5 |
| Cheese & wine tasting | **Fromagerie Barthélemy** | €15 |

**Tip:** Try “prix fixe” menus (menu du jour) for a full meal at a fixed price (~€25–€35).

---

## 7️⃣ Budget Breakdown (per person, 7 days)

| Category | Cost (mid‑range) |
|----------|------------------|
| Flights | €150 |
| Accommodation | €1,200 (average €170/night) |
| Transport (Navigo + occasional taxi) | €50 |
| Food & Drink | €300 |
| Attractions & Tours | €200 |
| Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | €100 |
| **Total** | **≈ €2,000** |

*Adjust upward for luxury or downward for budget.*

---

## 8️⃣ Quick Tips & Hacks

1. **Book tickets online** for museums and attractions to skip queues.  
2. **Use the “Paris Pass”** if you plan to visit many paid sites – it bundles entry fees and public transport.  
3. **Stay central** (1st–4th arrondissements) to minimize travel time.  
4. **Try local markets** (Marché d’Aligre, Marché des Enfants Rouges) for fresh food and affordable meals.  
5. **Learn basic French phrases** – locals appreciate the effort.  
6. **Carry a reusable water bottle** – tap water is safe and free.  
7. **Check opening hours** – many museums close on Mondays.  

---

## 9️⃣ Optional Add‑Ons

| Activity | Approx. Cost | Why It’s Worth It |
|----------|--------------|-------------------|
| **Seine Dinner Cruise** | €30–€50 | Romantic view of illuminated landmarks. |
| **Eiffel Tower Summit** | €25 (first floor) | Iconic photo opportunity. |
| **Wine & Cheese Tasting** | €40 | Cultural immersion. |
| **Day Trip to Giverny** | €35 | Monet’s garden, scenic. |
| **Cooking Class** | €70 | Learn to make French pastries. |

---

### Final Thought

Paris is a city that rewards curiosity. Mix the must‑see sights with spontaneous wandering, and you’ll discover hidden cafés, street art, and the everyday rhythm that makes the city unforgettable. Have a fantastic trip! 🌍✈️🍷
